title: Knee Cut / Folding Pass Dilemma by Steffen Banta
whyUseful: Steffen Banta analyzes the folding pass dilemma, teaching how to manage the knee shield and combine knee cut pressure with the folding/smash pass to successfully break through the opponent's guard.

title: How To Pass The Closed Guard Using The Sao Paulo Pass
whyUseful: Bernardo Faria demonstrates the classic Sao Paulo pass mechanics in detail — pinning the hips, using the head as a wedge, controlling the arms, and folding through with heavy pressure. Essential viewing for the tripod/folding pass system.
